title: Ratio & Proportion
description: Class 5 Maths: understand ratio as a comparison of two quantities, write and simplify ratios, find equivalent ratios and solve simple proportion problems — examples and tests.

topics.title: Understanding Ratio
topics.concept:
A ratio compares two quantities. If there are 3 apples and 2 oranges, the ratio of apples to oranges is 3 : 2 (read 'three to two').

Order matters: 3 : 2 is not the same as 2 : 3. A ratio can be simplified like a fraction by dividing both parts by a common factor (6 : 4 = 3 : 2).

examples.problem: There are 4 boys and 6 girls. Write the ratio of boys to girls in simplest form.

recap: A ratio compares two quantities, written a : b.
Simplify a ratio by dividing both parts by a common factor.

topics.title: Equivalent Ratios & Proportion
topics.concept:
Equivalent ratios are equal in value, like equivalent fractions: 1 : 2 = 2 : 4 = 3 : 6. Multiply or divide both parts by the same number.

A proportion says two ratios are equal. If 2 pens cost ₹10, then 4 pens cost ₹20 (double the quantity, double the cost).
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 420 90" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%;max-width:420px"><rect width="420" height="90" rx="14" fill="#f0f9ff"/><text stroke="none" x="210" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#0369a1">1 : 2  =  2 : 4  =  3 : 6</text></svg>

examples.problem: If 3 books cost ₹60, how much do 6 books cost?
examples.solution: Double the books → double the cost = ₹120.

recap: Make equivalent ratios by multiplying/dividing both parts equally.
A proportion states that two ratios are equal.

questions.q: 3 apples to 2 oranges is the ratio…
A recipe uses 2 cups flour to 1 cup sugar. For 4 cups flour, how much sugar?
questions.explanation: Double the flour → double the sugar = 2 cups.

questions.q: Share ₹100 between two friends in the ratio 3 : 2. The larger share is…
If 5 pens cost ₹25, what is the cost of 1 pen?
The ratio of 1 hour to 30 minutes is…
If 4 workers build a wall in the same time, then for double the work you need…
questions.explanation: Double the work → double the workers = 8.
